## Story Goal

Establish the **Angular frontend workspace** under `src/frontend/` that hosts two distinct application sur
faces — **Agent CRM** and **Customer Portal** — plus a small set of **reusable shared libraries** with strict dependency boundaries. Config
ure routing, environment configuration, HTTP client, API base URL wiring, global styles, linting, formatting, PrimeNG + PrimeIcons ba

seline, and an Arabic/English RTL/LTR direction foundation. Both applications must build for production and lint cleanly.

**In scope:** work
space scaffolding, shared library boundaries, PrimeNG integration proof, environment/runtime config plumbing, i18n/direction foundation (

mechanism only), lint/format, build verification.

**Not in scope:** business feature screens, full application shell UX (CRM-117), full translation content (CRM-116
), auth/session (CRM-110), API clients for capabilities that don't exist yet, complete custom design system, Angular Material, backend/API code

, CI quality gates (CRM-203), full test/architecture-test suite (CRM-202).

##

Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Environment variables missing at build time** — `environment.production.ts` values are the source of truth; CI substitution fail
ing should produce a build with clearly-wrong placeholder URLs. Enforce a runtime guard in `prov
ideAppConfig`: if `apiBaseUrl` is empty or equals a known sentinel like `REPLACE_ME`, throw at bootstrap. En

forced in `projects/platform/src/lib/config/provide-app-config.ts`.
- **Absolute API URLs in requests** — the `apiBaseUrlInterceptor` must skip URLs that already start with

`http://` or `https://`. Covered by unit test in task Test Plan #3.
- **Direction flash on first paint** — static
`dir="ltr"` on `<html>` matches the `en` default. If persisted locale is `ar`, `LocaleService` must update `<html dir>` before the

first change-detection cycle (use `APP_INITIALIZER`, not a component `ngOnInit`).
- **Unsupported persisted locale in

`localStorage`** — reject any value not in `APP_CONFIG.supportedLocales`; fall back to `defaultLocale`. Enforced in `provideLocale()`.
- **Cross-application
import attempts** — ESLint `no-restricted-imports` rejects `projects/agent-crm/*` from `customer-portal` and vice versa (

task 7.3).
- **Angular Material or competing UI library sneaks in** — ESLint pattern rule rejects `@angular/material*`.
Add a matching entry for `@mui/*`, `bootstrap`, `@ionic/angular` to prevent equ

ivalents.
- **PrimeNG theme conflict with library import order** — `styles.scss` must import `primeicons` and shared-ui tokens in the

order shown in task 5.4; otherwise CSS specificity of overrides is undefined.
- **Standalone bootstrap missing `prov
ideAnimationsAsync`** — PrimeNG will silently render without animations and some overlays (Dialog, O

verlayPanel) break. Both apps must include the provider (task 2).
- **Duplicate `.gitignore` entries** —

Angular ignores are already present at `.gitignore` lines 18–25; do not re-add.
- **`.editorconfig` conflic

ts** — root `.editorconfig` (270 B) already exists; if `ng new` writes its own, **merge**, do not overwrite the root file.
